title: Questions 172-175 refer to the following online chat discussion.
passage_1:
Devon Ilyich (2:34 P.M.)
Hello. This is Devon from the technical services team. How may I help?

Marisol Quintero (2:36 P.M.)
I have a colleague at a client site in Montana with an urgent issue. He is joining us now from his tablet.

Aaron Whitfield (2:37 P.M.)
My company-issued scanner has stopped responding. May I bring it to a local electronics shop? It holds files I have to reach.

Devon Ilyich (2:38 P.M.)
I’m afraid not, as that would breach our data security policy. May I ask how much longer you will be at that site?

Aaron Whitfield (2:38 P.M.)
I’ll be here for another ten days. Could you ship me a replacement unit?

Devon Ilyich (2:39 P.M.)
One moment. Let me bring in my team lead.

Priya Venkataraman (2:41 P.M.)
Hello, everyone. Devon has briefed me on the situation. The good news is that I can approve sending a replacement unit. However, it will not reach you until roughly this hour tomorrow. Does that work?

Aaron Whitfield (2:42 P.M.)
That’s fine. Thank you! Do you need my full site address?

Marisol Quintero (2:44 P.M.)
I have it, Aaron. Thanks for the quick help, Devon and Priya. Please let me know once it has been shipped.
